actualProvenance.head: a35034bce2288fb47c922f23fe4bacfbe5e25617
notes: Actual image app bundled without source instrumentation or Photon replacement.
Synthetic caller and CDN run in workerd workers, joined by real service bindings.
CDN is mapped as the image worker outbound service; no DNS or external network is used.
No counters are production memory measurements; standalone workerd does not prove platform enforcement.

normalization: Only local prototype, checkout and home path prefixes in JSON keys/values are normalized. Numeric observations, error/output/source/artifact hashes and raw counter fields remain unchanged; original JSON byte hashes are recorded.
limitations: Counter sums are simultaneous diagnostic checkpoints, not Cloudflare accounting or continuous peaks.
No forced GC or heap snapshots in the actual-entry memory comparisons.
Local standalone workerd has no production memory-limit enforcer.
Thirty-second post-disconnect waitUntil and runtime termination prevent unconditional cleanup guarantees.
The lease does not bound completed/unread responses, runtime prebuffering, GC or other isolates.
Dedicated ICC, EXIF orientation, CMYK and animated image fixture coverage was not completed.
Original complete publisher Cargo.lock is unavailable; reconstruction pins known embedded versions and verifies an unmodified baseline.
Scripts and original failed/successful receipts remain in the ignored prototype workspace; this receipt does not claim a new portable harness.
